en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a broad, unpaved street lined with low townhouses in an old European town. A horse-drawn cart stands to the left and a few pedestrians walk along the right side near arched gateways. The image caption and city name are printed in German, Hungarian, and Romanian. The reverse side bears the Hungarian word for postcard "Levelező-lap" with dotted address lines and a purple postal stamp.
